references.text: John the Baptist also proclaimed that the kingdom of God was near, which prepared the way for Jesus' message.
This verse marks the beginning of Jesus' public ministry and his proclamation that the kingdom of heaven is near, which directly aligns with the message in Matthew 10:7.
Luke provides a parallel account where Jesus sends out the seventy-two and gives them similar instructions to proclaim that the kingdom of God is near.
This verse describes a similar event where Jesus sends out the twelve and grants them power and authority, including the command to proclaim that the kingdom of God is near.
